text:
**Last few hours!**

Our crowdfunding campaign comes to an end tonight.

A month and a half ago, Wiebke and I launched it to help cover the legal costs of the two court cases we fought—and won—to have both of us legally recognized as mothers to our daughters. The rulings created important precedents that can help other families like ours.

We’ve been overwhelmed by the support so far. If you haven’t had a chance yet, there are just a few hours left to donate or share our story.

Thank you for standing with us. ❤️
